title: Evaluating the Substance of Transactions Involving the Legal Form of a Lease
summary: Addressed how to evaluate transactions structured to involve the legal form of a lease but lacking economic substance, requiring unbundling of fees and obligations. Superseded in 2019.

related.title: Leases
related.relationship: The standard that superseded SIC-27 in 2019 by replacing IAS 17 and restructuring lease scope guidance

related.title: Determining whether an Arrangement contains a Lease
related.relationship: A companion interpretation that addressed the related question of whether an arrangement contains a lease; also withdrawn in 2019
